course_description: A comprehensive study of artificial intelligence foundations, focusing on rational agents, uninformed and heuristic search strategies, adversarial game playing, constraint satisfaction problems, classical knowledge representation, probabilistic reasoning, supervised and unsupervised machine learning algorithms, and ethical considerations in AI systems design.

course_outcomes.co_description: Implement uninformed and heuristic search strategies to solve complex problem spaces within specified time constraints.
Develop supervised and unsupervised machine learning algorithms to predict outcomes from structured datasets.
Design knowledge representation systems that effectively model real-world constraints and logical relationships.
Evaluate the ethical implications of AI system design regarding bias, privacy, and societal impact.
